# CityWide Digital

> CityWide Digital is a Canadian service that builds and runs websites for local businesses which synchronise supported information from a Google Business Profile. Business owners update their information in Google; the website follows automatically.

## What the service is

A Google Business Profile–synced website takes supported business information from a Google Business Profile and publishes it on the website automatically. The direction is one way: Google Business Profile to website. Changes appear on the website as soon as they are saved in Google (near real-time). CityWide Digital manages the website design, hosting, maintenance and the sync; the business owner keeps the Google profile current.

Fields that synchronise: business name, address, phone number, website link, primary category, opening and holiday hours, menus, products, Google posts, and Google reviews and ratings.

Not synchronised: content that does not exist in Google, such as custom page copy, campaign landing pages, imagery outside the profile, and bespoke layouts. These are handled as one-off Site Concierge requests.

## Services

- GBP-synced websites: managed, auto-updating local business websites on a customer's own domain.
- Social Sync Pro: publishes a Google Business Profile post to connected social platforms.
- Listing Sync Pro: keeps name, address and phone consistent across 40+ directories.
- Review Engine: collects customer reviews by SMS or email and displays approved reviews on the website.
- Site Concierge: on-demand website changes requested in plain language.

## Plans (CAD, plus GST)

- Starter: $197/month. GMB-synced website, industry template, auto-updating content, custom domain support, social sync to Google plus 2 platforms, post scheduling, basic SEO, email support.
- Growth: $397/month. Everything in Starter, social sync to Google plus 3 platforms, 40+ directory listings, monthly performance report, priority support.
- Pro: $597/month. Everything in Growth, social sync to up to 10 platforms, Review Engine, AI chatbot intake, 3 Site Concierge credits per month, dedicated account manager.

30-day free trial with no card required. No setup fee. Cancel anytime. Most sites go live within 24–48 hours. Service area: Canada.
